abstract: Self-renewal is a feature common to both adult and embryonic stem (ES) cells, as well as tumor stem cells (TSCs). The cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor, p18(INK4c), is a known tumor suppressor that can inhibit self-renewal of tumor cells or adult stem cells. Here, we demonstrate an opposite effect of p18 on ES cells in comparison with teratoma cells. Our results unexpectedly showed that overexpression of p18 accelerated the growth of mouse ES cells and embryonic bodies (EB); on the contrary, inhibited the growth of late stage teratoma. Up-regulation of ES cell markers (i.e., Oct4, Nanog, Sox2, and Rex1) were detected in both ES and EB cells, while concomitant down-regulation of various differentiation markers was observed in EB cells. These results demonstrate that p18 has an opposite effect on ES cells as compared with tumor cells and adult stem cells. Mechanistically, expression of CDK4 was significantly increased with overexpression of p18 in ES cells, likely leading to a release of CDK2 from the inhibition by p21 and p27. As a result, self-renewal of ES cells was enhanced. Our current study suggests that targeting p18 in different cell types may yield different outcomes, thereby having implications for therapeutic manipulations of cell cycle machinery in stem cells.
abstract_ja: 自己複製は胚性幹（ES）細胞、成体幹細胞、そして腫瘍幹細胞（TSC）に共通する特徴である。サイクリン依存性キナーゼ阻害因子p18(INK4c)は、腫瘍細胞や成体幹細胞の自己複製を抑制しうる既知の腫瘍抑制因子である。本研究では、ES細胞と奇形腫細胞におけるp18の作用が逆であることを示す。予想外にも、p18の過剰発現はマウスES細胞と胚様体（EB）の増殖を促進し、一方で後期の奇形腫の増殖を抑制した。Oct4、Nanog、Sox2、Rex1といったES細胞マーカーの発現上昇はES細胞とEB細胞の両方で検出され、EB細胞では様々な分化マーカーの発現低下が同時に観察された。機序としては、p18の過剰発現によりES細胞でCDK4の発現が有意に増加し、その結果、p21およびp27による阻害からCDK2が解放されると考えられる。これによりES細胞の自己複製が促進される。本研究は、p18を標的とすることが細胞種によって異なる結果をもたらす可能性を示しており、幹細胞における細胞周期機構の治療的操作への示唆を持つ。
